## 問題
2025 年第二季所有物流商合計的平均配送天數？

## 回答 A
最終答案: 2.91
採用的定義與依據: 依語意層定義，配送天數為 shipments 中 delivered_ts 與 shipped_ts 的時間差（以天計），只計已送達出貨。期間依 orders.order_ts 加 8 小時（台北時間）歸屬於 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30，所有物流商合計 9,921 筆，平均 2.91 天。假設 order_ts 為 UTC，此假設未另行驗證。
SQL 1: ["SELECT order_id, order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5", "SELECT COUNT(*) n, ROUND(AVG(julianday(s.delivered_ts)-julianday(s.shipped_ts)),2) avg_days FROM shipments s JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=s.order_id WHERE s.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-04-01' AND datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours') < '2025-07-01'"]
  結果: [{'query': 'SELECT order_id, order_ts FROM orders ORDER BY order_ts LIMIT 5', 'columns': ['order_id', 'order_ts'], 'rows': [[520, '2024-12-30 00:03:20'], [16291, '2024-12-30 00:13:54'], [50530, '2024-12-30 00:17:31'], [47988, '2024-12-30 00:25:59'], [35154, '2024-12-30 00:28:46']], 'truncated': Fals

## 回答 B
最終答案: 2.91
採用的定義與依據: 語意層無對應定義，依 shipments 資料表計算：以 shipped_ts 落在 2025-04-01 至 2025-06-30 的出貨為範圍，配送天數為 delivered_ts 與 shipped_ts 的時間差（天）。所有物流商合計，平均只納入已送達的 9,947 筆（總出貨 11,128 筆）。檢查無重複訂單、無送達早於出貨的異常值，最短 0.63 天、最長 7.08 天。
SQL 1: SELECT shipment_id, order_id, carrier, shipped_ts, delivered_ts FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts LIKE '2025-04%' OR shipped_ts LIKE '2025-05%' OR shipped_ts LIKE '2025-06%' LIMIT 20
  結果: {'columns': ['shipment_id', 'order_id', 'carrier', 'shipped_ts', 'delivered_ts'], 'rows': [[1, 1, 'post', '2025-05-29 05:32:55', '2025-06-03 18:32:55'], [2, 2, 'blackcat', '2025-06-03 17:04:51', '2025-06-06 13:04:51'], [4, 4, 'blackcat', '2025-04-12 17:13:13', '2025-04-14 18:13:13'], [5, 6, 'blackca
SQL 2: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_total, COUNT(delivered_ts) AS n_delivered, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_ts < shipped_ts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negative_cnt FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01'
  結果: {'columns': ['n_total', 'n_delivered', 'avg_days', 'min_days', 'max_days', 'negative_cnt'], 'rows': [[11128, 9947, 2.91, 0.625, 7.083333333488554, 0]], 'truncated': False}
SQL 3: SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_orders, SUM(cnt) AS rows_in_dup FROM (SELECT order_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM shipments WHERE shipped_ts >= '2025-04-01' AND shipped_ts < '2025-07-01' GROUP BY order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)
  結果: {'columns': ['dup_orders', 'rows_in_dup'], 'rows': [[0, None]], 'truncated': False}

response: {"winner": "A", "reason": "兩者答案同為 2.91 天；A 依語意層定義，以訂單時間換算台北時區（+8 小時）歸屬季度，較貼近業務口徑。B 雖補充了重複、負值與極值檢查，但聲稱語意層無對應定義，且直接以 UTC 的 shipped_ts 切季度、未處理時區，口徑較不嚴謹。", "critical_error": false}
